# The paper worksheet stays in the van until the pilot closes

## Decision Question

Do crews stop carrying the paper worksheet once Tanager is live at their depot, or does the book stay in the van for the length of the pilot?

## Decision Outcome

Proposed, not agreed. Marta Kubik's position is that the book stays until the pilot formally closes and that the double entry is what that costs. Fiona Aitken's is that a crew carrying both will trust the paper, and the pilot will end up measuring the paper.

## Alternatives Considered

- Drop the book at cutover depots only and keep it everywhere else, which nobody could distinguish in practice from dropping it.
- Keep the book but stop writing in it, which Cal Merrick called dropping it with extra weight in the van.

## Approved By

Nobody yet. Written down as proposed because it keeps coming back, and because it hangs on a pilot close date that does not exist.

## Context

Hydrant and standpipe jobs have no asset in Harrow, so they have nowhere to go in Tanager either and they go in the book today. Nobody has said where they go tomorrow. That is a reason to keep the book that has nothing to do with how much anyone trusts the app, and it is not the reason either side has been arguing.
